学校へ行かない少女、春日野穹。ある日、彼女は兄への想いを募らせ、誰もいないはずの彼の教室へと忍び込む。そこで甘い幻想に浸っていた彼女は、不意に現れた肥満体型の男性教師にその姿を見られてしまう。抗いがたい状況下で、穹の繊細な身体は執拗な手つきによって弄ばれ、嫌悪感と同時に、脳髄を焼くような未知の熱い痺れを覚える。それは、彼女が初めて知る背徳的な快感だった。以来、二人の密会は彼女の家で続けられ、淫らな行為にふける穹。たとえその現場を最愛の兄に目撃されようとも、彼女の虚ろな瞳は、もはや兄の絶望の表情すら捉えられないほど、快楽の深淵に堕ちていた…。

Kasugano Sora, a girl who doesn't attend school. One day, her longing for her brother leads her to sneak into his supposedly empty classroom. While lost in a sweet fantasy, she is discovered by a corpulent male teacher who appears unexpectedly. Under irresistible circumstances, Sora's delicate body is toyed with by persistent hands, and along with revulsion, she feels an unknown hot numbness that burns her mind. It is an immoral pleasure she experiences for the first time. Since then, their secret meetings continue at her home, Sora indulging in lewd acts. Even if her beloved brother witnesses the scene, her vacant eyes, already fallen into the abyss of pleasure, can no longer even register his despairing expression...
